scenarios.name: User signs up with a valid email and password and lands on the welcome screen
User signs up with Google SSO and the account is linked to the same email
Password of exactly the 12-character minimum is accepted; 11 is rejected
Name with apostrophe and diacritics (O'Brien, Zoë) is stored and displayed unchanged
Pasting an email with leading and trailing spaces trims it before validation
Email already registered shows a sign-in link instead of a duplicate account
Network drop on submit keeps the form values and shows a retry message
Server 500 on submit shows a non-technical error and logs a correlation id
Expired verification link offers to resend instead of a dead end
First visit with no saved draft shows placeholder hints, not validation errors
Every field has a programmatic label read by a screen reader
Whole form can be completed by keyboard alone in a logical tab order
Error messages are announced and linked to their field
Password is never echoed in logs, analytics events or error payloads
Ten failed submits from one IP within a minute trigger rate limiting
Script tags in the name field are rendered as text, not executed
German labels fit the layout without truncation
Form works on the latest Safari iOS and Chrome Android
